query:
UPDATE sessions
         SET last_used_at = now(),
             idle_expires_at = LEAST(now() + make_interval(secs => $2), absolute_expires_at)
         WHERE id = $1
           AND idle_expires_at < LEAST(now() + make_interval(secs => $2)
                                         - make_interval(secs => $3),
                                       absolute_expires_at)
